In Hindu mythology, various deities and spiritual masters are depicted as Sharans, offering shelter and refuge to their devotees.

The name Sharan is a reminder of the inherent connection between the individual soul and the Divine, emphasizing the importance of trust, faith, and devotion in the spiritual journey.
